news.casting_brief: NASA astrophysics director, startup founder/engineers at Katalyst, mission planners; high-stakes dynamic between cautious agency and bold young company racing the clock.
news.script_brief: A startup gets 10 months to build and launch a rescue craft to save a falling $500M telescope. Central tension: impossible deadline, tight budget, untested robotic-arm docking. Beats: the pitch, the contract, the build sprint, the chase, the latch-on, the orbital boost gamble.
news.news_close_brief: With Swift's orbit decaying, Katalyst's Link spacecraft races to launch and rescue the $500 million mission. Whether three robotic arms can save it remains uncertain.

dramatic_state.dramatic_question: Can Faber's untested Link craft reach Swift, latch its three robotic arms, and boost the $500M telescope before it falls past saving?
dramatic_state.character_a_wants: To scrub the rushed mission and let Swift burn rather than gamble NASA's reputation on it
dramatic_state.character_b_wants: To launch Link in 10 months and latch its three robotic arms onto the falling Swift
dramatic_state.ending_change: Link launches from Wallops Island and latches on; Swift gets its orbital boost, but only after Faber overrides the abort order.
